recognize_zh: 淋巴結細針抽吸抹片中，可見多群圓形、大小不一的酵母菌體，每顆都有中央菌體與外圍透明、折光的厚莢膜暈，像一串泡泡；背景有少數淋巴細胞與組織球。成群的帶莢膜、大小不一酵母菌，應考慮 Cryptococcus。
features: Clusters of round to oval yeast forms of variable size
Each yeast has a central refractile body surrounded by a thick, clear capsular halo
Occasional budding forms within the clusters
Sparse background lymphocytes and a histiocyte in a proteinaceous, pink granular background
describe_en: Fine-needle aspiration smear of an abdominal lymph node shows a proteinaceous background with sparse lymphocytes and occasional histiocytes. Several clusters of round yeast forms of variable size are present, each with a central body surrounded by a thick, clear refractile capsule; occasional budding is seen and no hyphae are identified. The stain is not specified in the image (pink H&E/Pap-type appearance). Findings are suggestive of cryptococcal infection; confirmation with mucicarmine or India ink preparation and serum/CSF cryptococcal antigen is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are small, uniform and predominantly intracellular within histiocytes without a thick capsule.
Blastomyces yeasts show a thick double-contoured wall with broad-based budding rather than narrow-based budding and a wide clear capsule.
Talaromyces yeasts are small, uniform, intracellular and divide by central septation (fission) rather than budding.
Lipid droplets and glove starch lack a central organism; starch shows a Maltese-cross pattern under polarized light.
